scenes.speaker: Baraat Lawn
lines: Behind the banquet tent, older cousins huddle around a car boot with flavored vapes and illicit alcohol.
"Hey little cousin, you're in college now. Try this puff, nobody inside will ever know!"

choices.text: "No thank you, bhai. Uncle called me over to help with the music stage."
choices.feedback: Using family duties as an unarguable exit plan protects relationships without confrontation.

choices.text: "Not interested, guys. Let's go grab the kulfi instead!"
choices.feedback: Redirecting back to festive celebrations keeps the atmosphere joyful and clean.

scenes.speaker: Family Celebration
lines: You enjoyed the dance floor and delicious buffet with zero guilt and a clear conscience.
